tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground — the cream of a tweed amp. Most of every screen stays this colour (間, ma).

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Sunken ground: table heads, skeletons, input hover, card fills.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Raised ground for overlays only (modal, menu, popover, toast), always with a 1px `ink` border and `shadow-block`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on every `paper`; solid button fill and hover inversion. Lines use `rule`, not `ink`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper` and `paper-2`: hints, captions, meta, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled text and borders only — below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every structural line: control borders, card and sheet frames, table rules, dividers. Softer than `ink` so hairlines read finer; ≥ 6.8:1 on every `paper`, so control boundaries stay well above 3:1.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Inner dividers inside an ink frame (table rows). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ink` fills (solid buttons, hover inversion, tooltips, active pagination).

tokens.name: olivo
tokens.usage: The brand colour — Fender olive, Pantone 18-0527 TCX Olive Branch (approx.). Focus ring, active markers (dots, tab edge, nav underline), accent button, progress fill, accent figures. Text-safe on `paper` in both themes. On `paper-2` it holds 4.2:1 — use it there for marks, figures 24px+ and bold labels, not small body text.

tokens.name: on-olivo
tokens.usage: Text on `olivo` fills.

tokens.name: maple
tokens.usage: Amber of a maple neck. FILL ONLY, always with `ink` text (`on-maple`): the accent badge, the leading progress segment, cover blocks, text selection. Never text, never a border that carries meaning, never a status.

tokens.name: on-maple
tokens.usage: Text on `maple` fills.

tokens.name: shu
tokens.usage: Seal vermilion (朱, shuniku). DECORATIVE ONLY, for .ol-stamp seals. Never a status, never text outside a seal, never a border that carries meaning. 5.1:1 on washi paper, 5.9:1 on sumi paper.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Info status: text and 1px borders on `paper`, always with the word or ⓘ glyph.

tokens.name: matsu
tokens.usage: Success status: text and borders on `paper`, always with the word or ✓. Bluer than `olivo` so it never reads as the brand.

tokens.name: kitsune
tokens.usage: Warning status: text and borders on `paper`, always with the word or !. Darker and browner than `maple`; `maple` is never used for status.

tokens.name: beni
tokens.usage: Danger and validation errors, always with the word or ×. The only red in the system.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on solid `ai`, `matsu`, `kitsune` or `beni` fills.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Modal and Offcanvas.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: Line colour of the `.ol-scanlines` texture over an `ink` block. Decoration only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Big Shoulders Display, thin. One per page: hero names, section openers. Two lines at most.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Big Shoulders Display, thin. Page titles. Two lines at most.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Big Shoulders Display, thin. Section titles.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Big Shoulders Display. Headings inside content. The condensed display face is never used below 40px.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 600. The product wordmark in Navbar and Modal headers (the display face is never below 40px).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 600. Card, modal and toast titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 600. Accordion rows, alert titles, list item titles.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Sprat Condensed Black — numbers only. Oversized index numerals and hero figures.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Stats, prices, percentages, every amount of money and every quantity; table amount columns use figure-xs.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Counters inside components: carousel, pagination, tab indexes. Never below 16px.

styles.name: figure-s
styles.usage: Small counters: tab indexes, pagination numbers, list numbers. Never below 16px.

styles.name: figure-xs
styles.usage: Amounts set in running rows: table amount columns. The 16px floor of the figure face.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Three luthiers in Matsumoto build forty instruments a year.
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk. Lead paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every control is a box drawn with one line of ink.
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk. Default UI and reading text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk. Control text: inputs, menu rows, table cells.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk. Hints, captions, dense tables.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 500, sentence case. Keycaps, dense meta, palette footers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 500, sentence case (no uppercase): labels, buttons, badges, tabs, meta. The voice of the interface.

styles.name: label-l
styles.usage: Familjen Grotesk 500, sentence case. Large buttons.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Xanh Mono. Code, data values, timestamps, IDs. Amounts use the figure face (≥16px), not mono.

styles.name: kanji
styles.usage: Yuji Syuku 400 (brush). Kanji ornaments and vertical captions. Never the only label.

styles.name: kanji-s
styles.usage: Yuji Syuku 400. The kanji mark beside the Navbar brand.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Big Shoulders Display 800, UPPERCASE (the only uppercase in the system), inside .ol-stamp. Kanji in a stamp use the jp family. Short titles only.

spacing.note: 4px base. The large steps are the point: leave space-16 and up empty around anything important.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls, label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline (small), list row padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding inline (default), card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and modal padding, gutters of the 12-column grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; space above a display title.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page-level sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Ma — deliberate emptiness around a hero or a single statement.

radius.note: Square by default. Circles are reserved for things that are literally points.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every box: buttons, inputs, cards, modals, badges, images.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the radio mark, the status dot and the switch knob.

stroke.note: Line weights. Lines are `rule` unless a status colours them. Hairlines are 0.5px on retina screens.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Default border of every control, card, table and rule. Renders as a true 0.5px hairline on high-density screens (the stylesheet overrides it at ≥ 2dppx) and 1px elsewhere.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Focus ring (in `olivo`, never thinner — accessibility), active tab edge, nav underline, selected list edge.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Section rules above display titles and the footer rule; at most one per view.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a focused element and its `stroke-bold` `olivo` focus ring.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs, table toolbars.

tokens.name: control-m
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: control-l
tokens.usage: Hero calls to action, search fields.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Large Fab and xl Avatar.

tokens.name: control-area
tokens.usage: Minimum height of multi-line controls (Textarea).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest pointer target for any interactive element (WCAG 2.5.8): checkbox and radio rows, switches, small marks.

tokens.name: menu-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a Dropdown menu.

tokens.name: toast-width
tokens.usage: Width of a Toast.

tokens.name: tooltip-max-width
tokens.usage: Widest a Tooltip grows before its text wraps.

tokens.name: modal-width-s
tokens.usage: Width of a small Modal.

tokens.name: modal-width-m
tokens.usage: Width of a medium Modal.

tokens.name: modal-width-l
tokens.usage: Width of a large Modal.

tokens.name: offcanvas-width
tokens.usage: Width of an Offcanvas panel opened from the start or end edge.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Width of a Popover panel.

tokens.name: skeleton-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a block Placeholder.

layout.note: Page layout. Breakpoints are min-widths; CSS media queries can't read custom properties, so stylesheets repeat these values and the tokens document them.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of `Container`; content centres inside it.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phones and up.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets and up. Below it, a `Col` spans the full row unless it sets a `base` span.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: laptops and up.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktops; matches `container-max`.

shadow.note: No soft shadows. One hard, offset block shadow for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Modal, dropdown menu, popover, toast — anything above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hover state of `Card` with `interactive`; removed on press.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything else.

texture.note: Pitches of the decorative textures. Decoration only, never behind body text.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot pitch of `.ol-halftone`.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch-fine
tokens.usage: Dot pitch of `.ol-halftone--fine`.

tokens.name: scanline-pitch
tokens.usage: Repeat of `.ol-scanlines`: one line every pitch.

tokens.name: scanline-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of each `.ol-scanlines` line.

tokens.name: crosshair-size
tokens.usage: Size of the `+` marks of `.ol-crosshair`.

marker.note: Small marks and fixed-size boxes inside controls.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: The olive point of `Label dot`, the navbar's current-page dot and the toast meta dot.

tokens.name: dot-size-s
tokens.usage: The status dot inside `Badge dot`.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: The ink block of a checked Checkbox or Radio; the button's loading square.

tokens.name: knob-size
tokens.usage: The Switch knob.

tokens.name: check-size
tokens.usage: Checkbox and Radio box.

tokens.name: badge-height
tokens.usage: Height (and minimum width of `count`) of a Badge.

tokens.name: kbd-size
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of a Kbd cap.

tokens.name: kbd-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding of a Kbd cap.

tokens.name: thumb-width
tokens.usage: Width of the Range thumb block.

tokens.name: thumb-height
tokens.usage: Height of the Range thumb block and its input.

tokens.name: switch-width
tokens.usage: Width of the Switch track.

tokens.name: switch-height
tokens.usage: Height of the Switch track.

glyph.note: Sizes of typographic glyphs used as icons (→ ↓ × ↗), set in `mono`.

tokens.name: glyph-s
tokens.usage: Select arrow and small affixes.

tokens.name: glyph-m
tokens.usage: Button arrows.

tokens.name: glyph-l
tokens.usage: The CloseButton ×.

tokens.name: glyph-xl
tokens.usage: The Accordion +/− sign.

motion.note: Jo-ha-kyū: begin slow, accelerate, stop dead. Every duration, curve and stagger is one of these tokens; under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 1ms (styles/motion.css). The stepped motion-* timings are deprecated and kept only until each component moves to the v2 tokens; motion-nudge and motion-press stay as distances.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Jo-ha-kyū — the default curve: begins slow, accelerates, stops dead. Anything that travels: unroll, slide, draw, stamp, fold.

tokens.name: ease-effect
tokens.usage: Opacity and colour changes (M3 default effects).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Small UI moves (M3 standard spatial, clamped: no overshoot).

tokens.name: ease-print
tokens.usage: Mokuhanga passes and segmented progress only.

tokens.name: dur-s
tokens.usage: Effects.

tokens.name: dur-m
tokens.usage: Controls.

tokens.name: dur-l
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, unrolls.

tokens.name: dur-xl
tokens.usage: Pages, folds.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between items in a sequence.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use --dur-s with --ease-effect (colour/opacity) or --ease-standard (small moves). Hover inversions and check marks.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use --dur-m with --ease-standard. Arrow nudges and the Switch knob.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use --dur-m or --dur-l with --ease-move. Underlines drawing in.

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use the shodo enso loop (.ol-enso). One turn of a loading square (repeats).

tokens.name: motion-turn
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use the shodo enso loop (.ol-enso). One turn of the Spinner square in four steps (repeats).

tokens.name: motion-blink
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use --dur-xl based loops. One blink cycle of the Spinner blocks (repeats).

tokens.name: motion-blink-step
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use --stagger. Delay between one Spinner block and the next.

tokens.name: motion-sweep
tokens.usage: Deprecated (stepped motion, replaced by the v2 tokens). Use the kumiko or shishi-odoshi loops. One cycle of the Placeholder sweep (repeats). Ambient loops are exempt from the 80–200ms transition range.

tokens.name: motion-nudge
tokens.usage: How far an arrow moves on hover.

tokens.name: motion-press
tokens.usage: How far a button moves while pressed.

tokens.name: underline-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of link underlines.

tokens.name: underline-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between text and its underline.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Lifts a hovered or focused cell above its neighbours in joined groups (shared borders), so its whole border and focus ring show.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers: above the sticky navbar, Modal, Offcanvas and Fab; below toasts and tooltips.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and offcanvas with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.
